integrity: The ground-state polynomial is supported by a finite exact inclusion-exclusion identity and two reproducible exhaustive C++17 algorithms with different enumeration methods. Historical-priority uncertainty remains for unindexed Ising-polynomial or binary edge-colouring tables.
scientific_limitations: The results concern only the finite labelled, uniform-coupling, classical Ising cage at zero temperature; no Heisenberg, finite-temperature or thermodynamic-limit assertion is made. Published 36-state plateau and dodecahedral perfect matching results are credited.
title: Complete zero-temperature Ising degeneracies of the icosidodecahedral cage
